environment.isolation_note: No git remote, so origin/HEAD is unresolvable and worktree.base-check returns shouldDegrade:true / fork-ref-unknown. GSD sequential fallback is correct (#683). Do NOT force worktree dispatch and do NOT create a remote. dispatch-isolation re-resolves to harness-worktree on every read and re-persists it, so re-arm before EVERY dispatch: gsd-tools query dispatch-isolation --raw --phase KPL-03 --force-isolation none. Without this the isolation guard hook refuses the Agent() call. Do not set workflow.use_worktrees=false as a workaround.

open_items.item: D-06 restoration only partly implemented; no remaining plan owns the renderer
open_items.detail: 03-11 implemented the window-level half of D-06 (validated on-screen bounds and fullscreen, clamped to the current display) and honestly disclosed that the renderer-semantic half is not implemented: sidebar visibility, pane sizes, destination, surviving selected task, semantic scroll anchor, and recoverable editor draft (D-06, 03-CONTEXT.md:28). Cause: no renderer file was in 03-11's authorized scope. This is the THIRD instance of the same structural defect as O-1 and O-9. Across all twelve plans' files_modified, every plan declaring apps/desktop/renderer/* or packages/web-ui/* (03-01, 03-03, 03-04, 03-07, 03-09) is complete, and none of the remaining plans (03-05 store/recovery, 03-08 performance, 03-06 packaged/tooling) touches either path. The renderer half of D-06 therefore has no owner and will not be delivered by any planned work. Severity precision: 03-11's must-have is worded as a restriction ('includes only D-06 semantic state... transient dialogs/progress/auth/raw focus never restore'), so restoring a strict subset does not violate that must-have as written - this is a gap against D-06 intent, not a failed plan assertion. Wants a gap-closure plan, or an explicit recorded decision that v1 restores window geometry only. Decide at /gsd-verify-work.

open_items.item: Wake/reconnect has no powerMonitor listener - deliberately NOT a GAP-1 item
open_items.detail: 03-08 disclosed that wake/reconnect is measured through a proxy because no OS-level powerMonitor listener is wired into the shipped app. Check against the decisions before treating this as a gap: D-18 says 'No correctness step depends on a timer, socket, online flag, wake event, or graceful shutdown', and D-43 asks only that wake/reconnect work be measured. The absence is therefore compliant by design. Adding a listener would be a legitimate retry hint (D-18 permits hints) but is not required for correctness. Do NOT fold into GAP-1: unlike O-1/O-11/O-12, nothing here is unreachable that the decisions say must be reachable. Recorded so a later reader does not 'fix' a deliberate design choice. Also disclosed: Quick Entry open-to-focus measures first-open-per-session only, because the window is resident and repeat opens are a different, faster scenario.

phase_level_gap.root_cause: One structural defect, not four unrelated bugs. Every executor disclosed correctly; the fault is the phase's allocation of files across plans, which leaves late-discovered integration work with no owner.
phase_level_gap.ownership_check: Across all twelve plans' files_modified, every plan owning main/index.ts (03-01, 03-10), preload/* (03-01, 03-02, 03-03, 03-05, 03-10) or renderer/* and packages/web-ui/* (03-01, 03-03, 03-04, 03-07, 03-09) is complete. The remaining plans 03-08 and 03-06 are tests, tooling and docs only and touch none of those paths.
phase_level_gap.recommendation: Close O-1, O-11, O-12 and O-15 together in ONE gap-closure plan owning main/index.ts, preload/{contracts,index}.ts and the renderer/web-ui paths. Wiring them separately would re-create the cross-plan file contention that caused this. O-9 proves the class is closable: 03-11 shut it with real evidence against the shipped entry point once a single plan was authorized to own the file. Alternatively record an explicit decision that some are out of v1 scope - but decide rather than letting them pass silently.
phase_level_gap.credential_note: O-15 is the most consequential of the four: an unwired credential adapter means the shipped app's credential path is not the safeStorage-backed one that 03-02 built and tested. Verify what bootstrap() actually uses before any ship claim about credential protection.
